description: This file defines the 'RangedStream' class used for creating digital signatures in PDFs by excluding certain ranges from the original stream.

classes.name: RangedStream
classes.description: A stream wrapper that exposes only specific ranges of an underlying stream, used for signing PDFs.

classes.name: RangedStream.Range
classes.description: Represents a range within the stream with an offset and length.

methods.name: RangedStream
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a ranged stream with an original stream and specified ranges.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream, constrained to the specified ranges.

methods.name: Position
methods.description: Gets or sets the current position within the stream according to the ranges.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the total length of the combined ranges.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Not implemented; placeholder for flushing the stream.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeking is not supported in this implementation.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Write operation is not supported; throws NotImplementedException.
